scope: XGCreateTextureComputer (ordinal 11) with default layout 0 for a bounded subset. Identical guest and XMem dependency; complete layouts and sampled element addresses compared against the supplied Xbox XG DLL.
subset: 26 four-byte color formats; five square and rectangular shapes from 4x4 through 512x512 including the Frosty 512x512 descriptor; one mip and slice, one sample, layout 0, flags 1, 5, 0x100001, 0x100005, 0x200001, 0x200005, 0x300001 or 0x300005, zero alignment and quality. Other combinations are unsupported.
